title: 3dinfill
description: A program to fill holes in volumes.

niter.description: Do not allow the fill function to do more than NITER passes.
niter.title: Number of Iterations

blend.description: Method for assigning a value to a hole.
blend.title: Blend Method

minhits.description: Criterion for considering a zero voxel to be a hole. Can only be used with -blend SOLID.
minhits.title: Minimum Hits

ed.description: Erode N times then dilate N times to get rid of hanging chunks. Values filled in by this process get value V.
ed.title: Erode and Dilate Parameters

mask.description: Provide mask dataset to select subset of input.
mask.title: Mask Dataset

mask_range.description: Specify the range of values to consider from mask dataset.
mask_range.title: Mask Range

cmask.description: Provide cmask expression. Voxels where expression is 0 are excluded from computations.
cmask.title: CMask Expression
